radiation: Tiny, fast bits from the Sun and space. A little is fine. A lot is bad for your body.
dose: How much radiation your body has collected so far.
sol: One day on Mars. It is a little longer than a day on Earth.
flare: A giant flash on the Sun.
lifeSupport: The air, water, warmth and plants that keep the crew alive.
shielding: Thick walls and the storm shelter that stop radiation.
science: The rover and the lab that make discoveries.
